About RankForge

SEO without the noise.

RankForge Kenya is an SEO and organic-growth agency based in Nairobi. We help businesses improve search visibility, attract qualified organic traffic and turn their websites into stronger lead-generation channels.

Our work combines technical understanding, search behaviour, content strategy, commercial thinking and disciplined prioritisation — practical SEO built around business objectives, not generic marketing packages or vanity metrics.

Who We Serve

Working with businesses that need stronger search visibility

We work with Kenyan SMEs, professional-service firms, ecommerce stores, hospitality and travel businesses, B2B companies and established local companies that want online acquisition to become a repeatable channel. We also support regional East African brands.

Professional services & B2B

For firms whose customers search before they enquire, we focus on the commercially important queries that connect directly to qualified leads.

Ecommerce & retail

Product and category architecture, search intent and visibility work that helps stores compete where buying decisions begin.

Local & hospitality

Local SEO for businesses targeting Nairobi, other Kenyan cities or multiple locations, so customers can find you on Google.

Our Approach

Principles that guide every engagement

RankForge treats SEO as a growth discipline: diagnose carefully, prioritise ruthlessly, execute systematically and keep improving.

Commercial relevance

We prioritise searches and improvements connected to actual business opportunities — visibility that leads to enquiries, not just rankings.

Technical clarity

We solve the structural problems that make websites harder for search engines and users to understand, from crawlability to site architecture.

Useful content

We build content around genuine customer questions and search intent, planned with clear purpose instead of published for its own sake.

Continuous improvement

We treat SEO as an evolving growth channel, measured and refined over time, rather than a one-off checklist project.

How We Work

A disciplined four-stage process

01

Diagnose

Understand the website, search landscape, competitors and commercial priorities.

02

Prioritise

Identify the improvements most likely to strengthen visibility and customer acquisition.

03

Implement technical, structural and content improvements systematically.

04

Measure search performance and continuously refine opportunities.

Focused execution, measured results

Every recommendation we make is tied to search visibility, qualified traffic and the commercial goals of your business.
